_about: Freely licensed stadium photos from Wikimedia Commons for Suite hero backgrounds. Files are Wikimedia's largest standard renditions (3840px wide, or 1920px when the original is under 3840px), not the full-resolution originals: upload.wikimedia.org rate-limited original downloads from this client (HTTP 429, retry-after 600s, repeated). original_url points at the full-resolution file. CC BY / BY-SA images require attribution with the credit_line; BY-SA derivatives must keep BY-SA.
gaps: ohio-stadium/night: no freely licensed wide interior night shot found on Commons
neutral: 4 found; 2 are crowd close-ups rather than full-bowl views
